clue.text: Go from house to house in bread round

definitions.meaning: to call at one front door after another, as a canvasser or reporter does
a thick slice cut from a loaf

explanation.definitionFit: Canvassers call door to door, and a thick hunk of loaf is nicknamed after the slab outside a front door.

clue.text: As the poet Maro is otherwise known?

indicators.note: otherwise says the letters of the name are arranged another way

explanation.surface: Asking the alternative name for the poet Maro.
explanation.walkthrough: Maro was Virgil's family name; Khayyam, the Persian poet of the Rubaiyat, has these letters as his first name.
explanation.definitionFit: The Persian poet Khayyam's given name.

clue.text: One who submits to the precepts of authority

definitions.text: One who submits to the precepts of authority

parts.words: One who submits to the precepts of authority
parts.note: a precept was a council's formal demand for local tax, so whoever pays it submits to the local authority

explanation.definitionFit: A householder who paid local property tax to the council.

clue.text: Opponents across the table ignored in appeal for pact

indicators.note: ignored means these letters are left out of the longer word

parts.note: an entreaty is an earnest appeal
East and North are opponents at bridge

explanation.surface: Negotiators ignore the plea of the other side to reach an agreement.
explanation.walkthrough: At bridge, East and North sit on opposing sides, so E and N are opponents.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal agreement between states.

clue.text: Peculiar sight seen in opera — une omitted in maiden production

indicators.note: peculiar says the letters are rearranged into something odd

parts.note: une is French for one, giving I

explanation.surface: An odd spectacle at the opera where a French word is left out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'omitted' says that I (une, French for a, one) is taken from the letters of SIGHT SEEN IN OPERA before they are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Reproduction from an unfertilised egg, without a male.

clue.text: Attire coming back in Eastbourne, ay

annotationWithheld.why: Attire coming back in Eastbourne, say (6): ENROBE is not hidden backwards in 'Eastbourne, say' (that gives ENRUOB...), and no sound or charade reading builds it honestly
annotationWithheld.clue: Attire coming back in Eastbourne, ay

clue.text: Sign of power in an advocate

definitions.meaning: the small raised index in maths showing to what power a number is raised
a champion or supporter of a cause

explanation.definitionFit: A raised index shows mathematical power, and a promoter of an idea is also so called.

clue.text: Heat in middle of large kiln

indicators.note: middle of says take the central letter of the word large

parts.note: an oast is a kiln for drying hops

explanation.surface: Warmth deep inside a big furnace.
explanation.walkthrough: An oast house is a Kentish building with a kiln for drying hops.
explanation.definitionFit: To cook in an oven is to apply strong heat.

clue.text: Small poser for one in loco parentis

parts.note: baby describes something small, as in baby carrots
a sitter poses for an artist

explanation.surface: A little model acting in place of a parent.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone minding children while parents are out stands in for them.

clue.text: Upset gin in boneshaker

parts.note: to upset or unnerve someone is to rattle them
a gin is a snare or trap for animals

explanation.surface: A spilled drink of gin aboard a jolting old vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gin' looks like the drink but is the old word for a snare. A boneshaker is a rickety old vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: A rattling, decrepit old car or bicycle is called by both names.

clue.text: French cleric born in Lincoln

indicators.note: in says one piece is placed inside the other here

parts.note: Abe Lincoln, the American president

explanation.surface: A French priest whose birthplace was Lincoln.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lincoln' looks like the English city but is Abraham Lincoln, ABE.
explanation.definitionFit: The title given to a priest or abbot in France.

clue.text: When at sea you may gamble on this game

definitions.text: When at sea you may gamble on this game

parts.words: When at sea you may gamble on this game
parts.note: a ship at sea lurches fore and aft and is thrown about, and the two motions together also name an old coin-throwing gambling game

explanation.definitionFit: A game where players throw coins at a mark and then toss them, betting on heads, and a ship's motions in rough water.

clue.text: Drunken order to carry noble liquor, so-called

annotationWithheld.why: Drunken order to carry noble liquor, so-called (10): BARLEYCORN; no parse of 'Drunken order to carry noble' found that builds the letters (EARL leaves BYCORN, which no order gives)
annotationWithheld.clue: Drunken order to carry noble liquor, so-called

clue.text: Disheartened labourer is blue

indicators.note: losing its heart means the middle letter of the word for the labourer goes

parts.note: a navvy is a manual labourer on roads or railways

explanation.walkthrough: 'Disheartened' looks like sadness, matching 'blue', but it removes the middle V of NAVVY, a British word for a road or railway labourer.
explanation.definitionFit: A dark shade of the colour of the sea, named after the uniform of sailors.

clue.text: Politically uncommitted about role in New York

indicators.note: in says the next pieces sit inside the abbreviation for the city

parts.note: on means about or concerning
a part is an actor's role

explanation.surface: A neutral performer takes a part in New York.
explanation.definitionFit: Belonging to or backing no political faction.

clue.text: Port made from aromatic plant

definitions.meaning: a Russian port on the White Sea
a herb, angelica, also a name for a dead-nettle

explanation.definitionFit: The Russian port Arkhangelsk takes this English name, and angelica is also called by it.

clue.text: Tot on the way to bed

definitions.text: Tot on the way to bed

parts.words: Tot on the way to bed
parts.note: a small drink of spirits taken last thing at night, not a sleepy child

explanation.definitionFit: A last drink taken before going to sleep.

clue.text: Repmach phone for sounding indistinct

parts.note: the page's Repmach is a misprint of reproach, and a slur is an insult or reproach
to ring someone is to phone them

explanation.surface: A rebuking telephone call that is hard to make out.
explanation.definitionFit: Running words together when speaking, as a drunk does, makes speech blurred.

clue.text: American Indian belief many latterly discarded

indicators.note: latterly points to the end of the word, where the piece is thrown away

parts.note: a creed is a set of beliefs
D is the Roman numeral for 500, so many

explanation.surface: A Native American faith abandoned by many in recent times.
explanation.walkthrough: 'many' gives D, 500 in Roman numerals, a common crossword trick.
explanation.definitionFit: A Native North American people of Canada and the northern plains.

clue.text: What's good for damaged crania?

indicators.note: damaged says the letters of crania are knocked into a new shape

explanation.surface: Asking what remedy helps bruised skulls.
explanation.definitionFit: A herbal remedy rubbed on bruises and bumps.

clue.text: Complaint that won't stand up to examination

definitions.text: Complaint that won't stand up to examination

parts.words: Complaint that won't stand up to examination
parts.note: an ailment that vanishes when a doctor looks, because it exists only in the patient's anxious imagination

explanation.definitionFit: Persistent worry about being ill with no real illness found.

clue.text: Open unused tradesmen's entrance

parts.note: something left over is unused

indicators.note: entrance of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: An unused back door for deliveries stands open.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tradesmen's entrance' looks like a side door but gives T.
explanation.definitionFit: Done openly, not hidden.

clue.text: A little henna from a coiffure

indicators.note: A little says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A hairdo coloured with a dash of henna.
explanation.definitionFit: A rounded, bushy style of naturally curly hair.

clue.text: Carry child by sweetheart

parts.note: a tot is a small child
the heart of the word sweet is its middle letter, an old crossword joke

explanation.surface: Lugging an infant along beside a lover.
explanation.definitionFit: To haul or lug something about.

clue.text: Removing painter from cricket side after throwing

indicators.note: after places the cricket side behind the throwing piece

parts.note: to cast is to throw
the off side is one half of a cricket field

explanation.surface: Getting an artist out of a cricket team after a bowling stint.
explanation.walkthrough: A painter is the rope that moors a boat; the off side is the half of a cricket field facing the batsman's bat side.
explanation.definitionFit: Letting go of the mooring line frees a boat to leave its berth.

clue.text: Free partners to split up

indicators.note: split says the word up is broken open so that pieces go inside it

parts.note: North and South are partners at the bridge table
taken as written

explanation.surface: Release couples so they can break up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'split' signals that the last word is broken open; bridge players sitting North and South are a partnership, a frequent crossword device.
explanation.definitionFit: To unblock, as a verb meaning to clear or release.

clue.text: Replace lost nail or stud

indicators.note: to replace is to put back in a new arrangement, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A DIY instruction to put back a missing nail or stud.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stud' looks like a metal fixing alongside the nail, but it means a breeding horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A male horse kept for breeding is said to be at stud.
